net.ooder.common.database

类 ConnectionWrapper

  • java.lang.Object
    • net.ooder.common.database.ConnectionAdapter
      • net.ooder.common.database.ConnectionWrapper
  • 所有已实现的接口:
    AutoCloseable, Connection, Wrapper

    public class ConnectionWrapper
extends ConnectionAdapter

    Title: 常用代码打包

    Description: An implementation of the Connection interface that wraps an underlying Connection object. It releases the connection back to a connection pool when Connection.close() is called.
